gen-dafont-college-gf-anek-latin: Anek Latin reads tall and unhurried, its lowercase nearly touching the capitals while the curves stay open instead of curling shut. College supplies the muscle, every curve stout as a stem.
gen-dafont-college-gf-anek-malayalam: College is all heavy, uniform curves and wide counters. Anek Malayalam follows with lowercase nearly at capital height, plus curve tips that stop short of touching, clean and contemporary.
gen-dafont-college-gf-anek-odia: College draws heavy, rounded forms with big counters and no shift between stems and connecting strokes, a loud and confident start. Anek Odia then carries paragraphs gently, its rounds left unsealed.
gen-dafont-college-gf-anek-tamil: College looks drawn with a round-tipped pen, heavy and confident. Anek Tamil brings big round lowercase bowls and an s that looks half unwrapped, the softer partner to that bold stroke.
gen-dafont-college-gf-anek-telugu: Anek Telugu moves in wide, tall bowls and unlatched rounds. College leads with heavy, zero-contrast strokes, so headings hit hard and the text beneath keeps its open, easy rhythm.
gen-dafont-college-gf-anuphan: College has no hairlines to squint at, just heavy uniform curves and big counters that hold up when the size drops. Anuphan adds big round bowls with clear gaps.
gen-dafont-college-gf-arimo: Arimo stands tall, with a high mean line and gaps in its rounds. College is the one to make noise, with uniform heavy strokes, while Arimo does the quiet work of carrying text.
gen-dafont-college-gf-armata: College is built on a monoline skeleton, heavy and bold. Armata matches that clarity with spacious gaps between characters and lowercase bodies filling most of the letter height.
gen-dafont-college-gf-athiti: Approachable and contemporary, Athiti leaves a visible gap in each s and sets its mean line high. And College adds the authority, with heavy curves and big counters in a tall lowercase.
gen-dafont-college-gf-atkinson-hyperlegi: Plain, heavy outlines lead in College. Atkinson Hyperlegible follows with wide-set terminals on s and capitals clipped beside its lowercase, so paragraphs read in a friendly, steady stride.
